messages.subject: Latin characters problem
parts:
Hi,

Rattle on french language doesn't show accentuates letters. In place,
it put a lot of crossed box. And it doesn't show the fourth source
option neither. There's some format mistake in the menu too.
I try it on two different computers, same thing.

System : Debian sid amd64.
Rattle version 2.6.6 (10 apr 2011).
R version 2.13.1
Rgtk2 version 2.20.14-1.

messages.author: a5571fe915a2be47
messages.subject: Re: Latin characters problem
parts:
Eureka. I solve it ! Yeehaa (I'm american).
Well it was effectively an UTF-8 coding problem, because my system was
in ISO coding (/etc/default/locale).
So I switch its in UTF-8 by the command (under debian) : dpkg-
reconfigure locales
then I choose fr_FR.UTF-8 instead of fr-FR@euro ISO-8859-15,
then I reboot
then it works !
It works fine, no latin characters problems (with witch the Execute
button action will not works with the Data menu because Data was
translated by Donn[x]es instead of Données) .
So ok, it's fine now.
Maybe a message in the Rattle website for warning unix users to switch
their systems in UTF-8 will be fine too.

Thanks,

(let's Rattle now...)
